T07_previously_routed_pty_resize_finding.what_the_prior_finding_cited: artifacts/wave_W57/W57_REPAIR164_ROUTE_KEYED_TO_GJ2_051.json -> corrected_owner_route.secondary_defect_newly_surfaced.evidence = 'in-app runtime sidecar .tmp/w57-repair164/gate/gate-1.runtime.json reports pty_resize=FAIL while the packaged terminal readback PASSes'
T07_previously_routed_pty_resize_finding.why_that_citation_is_not_evidence: The sidecar's pty_resize field is an UNINITIALISED LITERAL DEFAULT, not a measurement. Verified independently in this dispatch: Select-String over all of src/ for 'pty_resize' returns exactly one hit, src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py:1994, which is the literal seed inside the checks dict of _run_packaged_smoke. No code path in the artifact ever assigns checks['pty_resize']. The artifact requests the resize at wx_shell.py:2218 (smoke_ssh.resize_shell_pty(123, 45)) but records no verdict about it. The maintained gate deliberately skips that payload field (wx_packaged_smoke.py:206) and re-derives the real verdict from the disposable loopback server's observed wire sizes (:212-225), which is unreachable on the timed_out branch of the committed gate. So on the committed gate's timeout path BOTH the artifact's pty_resize=FAIL and the gate's pty_resize=FAIL are defaults, and the prior finding was routed on a seeded constant.

measurement_that_settles_it.harness: .tmp/w57-run169/measure_resize.py - builds the same env contract the gate builds, uses the repository's own maintained tests/support/mock_ssh_server.py, and observes the server-side wire sizes. No gate, artifact or test was edited.
measurement_that_settles_it.pass_criterion: identical to the gate's own: any((96,31) in pty_sizes) and any((123,45) in resize_sizes)
measurement_that_settles_it.corroboration: the corrected working-tree gate, which now reaches its own :212-225 recomputation, independently reports pty_resize=PASS in 8/8 runs

T07_previously_routed_pty_resize_finding.conclusion: The PTY resize DOES reach the wire in the frozen packaged candidate. HPC-W05-TERM-023 ('window/widget resize updates PTY size') is satisfied by the candidate. The W20 closed-owner route for PKGREG-PTY-RESIZE-NOT-DELIVERED is WITHDRAWN as unfounded. W57's blocker count drops from the two asserted in repair 164 to exactly one.
T07_previously_routed_pty_resize_finding.what_survives_from_repair_164: RC-1 itself is confirmed: the artifact's own payload reports pty_resize=FAIL as a constant default. That is a real REPORTING defect (the artifact's self-report is uninformative for this check), and it is folded into the T06 finding's evidence chain rather than kept as a second blocker. It is a reporting-honesty defect, not a resize defect, and it must not be 'fixed' by editing wx_shell.py:1994 to PASS.

root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.note: The concurrent dispatch's RC-1..RC-7 were re-derived from source here rather than accepted on prose. Three confirmed, one corrected, three confirmed as descriptions of the gate.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-1_CONFIRMED: src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py:1994 seeds checks['pty_resize']='FAIL'; Select-String over src/ returns exactly that one hit; no assignment ever sets it to PASS in the packaged probe.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-2_CONFIRMED: src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py:1997 seeds checks['clean_shutdown']='FAIL'; the only checks['clean_shutdown']='PASS' in the file is line 1595, inside the separate fresh-user probe whose own dict is seeded at 1563-1568. The packaged probe never closes it.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-3_CONFIRMED: The packaged probe writes result='PASS' at wx_shell.py:2479 at the single point where the phase-4 readback and transfer-queue render succeed; it is not derived from the checks dict.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-4_CONFIRMED: src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py:2507-2509: _run_packaged_smoke(...); app.MainLoop(); return 0 if smoke_state['result']=='PASS' else 1.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-5_CONFIRMED: wx_packaged_smoke.py:206 excludes process_started, clean_shutdown and pty_resize from the payload copy.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-6_CONFIRMED: wx_packaged_smoke.py:212-225 re-derives pty_resize purely from the loopback server's wire sizes. This dispatch measured that criterion directly: PASS 6/6.
root_cause_chain_verified_independently_.RC-7_CORRECTED: The claim that clean_shutdown is 'partly tautological' is overstated. main() returns only after app.MainLoop() returns, so returncode==0 genuinely requires the artifact's event loop to have terminated. A non-terminating MainLoop yields no returncode at all. The gate's clean_shutdown is therefore a real termination measurement, not a tautology - which is exactly why it reported FAIL in the 9 hang runs and PASS in the 9 green runs. The residual valid part of RC-7 is that the artifact's own clean_shutdown self-report is never consulted (RC-2).
